title: Skill registry entry
description: arch §10.2 store 2: versioned skill folders (SKILL.md pattern) + capability manifest per skill (declared capture-surface requirements, checked at load, graceful degradation on lesser tiers). Version history = Ledger 6; evaluation evidence keys via L7. version and evidence_links are load-bearing (must-map).

description.description: What the skill does / when it triggers (SKILL.md frontmatter)

namespace.description: Registry scope (arch §10.2: skills at all scopes incl. personal namespaces; personal co-owned)

version.description: Load-bearing (must-map): current version — L6 key (git sha of the skill folder)

capability_manifest.description: arch §10.2: declared capture-surface requirements; checked at load; graceful degradation on lesser tiers

capture_surface.description: Which capture tier the skill requires

tools.description: Tools the skill declares it uses (gate cross-checks at run time)

evidence_links.description: Load-bearing (must-map): L7 record ids attributing performance to this skill's versions

body_path.description: Path to the SKILL.md body within the skill folder

lineage_sidecar.description: Path to the skill's PROV-lite lineage sidecar (promotion gates read it — arch §10.5)
